title: Practical 2 dataset entry
description: One row of the Rukiga/Yoruba short-text dataset. See docs/SCHEMA.md for the human-readable version and field-by-field rationale. Rukiga (cgg) replaced Luganda (lug) 2026-09-29 alongside adding web-scraping as a valid source_type — see DECISIONS.md D026/D027.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this entry, e.g. 'cgg-0001'.

language.description: ISO 639-3 code of the entry's language. Only these two are in scope for this dataset.

text.description: The original-language text (Rukiga or Yoruba). Required, non-empty.

translation_en.description: English translation of `text`. REQUIRED for every entry (see DECISIONS.md). For web-scraped entries this is either the source site's own human translation (translation_source="site") or a machine translation (translation_source="machine") — see translation_source below.

contributor_id.description: Anonymous code identifying who contributed this entry, e.g. 'C001'. Never a real name. REQUIRED for human-collected source_types; optional ("N/A" or blank) for source_type="web-scraped", which has no individual human contributor — see DECISIONS.md D027.

region.description: Free-text region/locality associated with the entry (optional).

date_collected.description: Month the entry was collected, format YYYY-MM.

source_type.description: How this entry originated. 'web-scraped' means sourced from an openly-licensed website rather than consented human collection — see source_url/site_name/retrieved_date/source_license/translation_source below, all REQUIRED when source_type is 'web-scraped'.

reviewed.description: True once at least one human review layer has looked at this entry.

reviewer_id.description: Anonymous code of the reviewer who most recently reviewed this entry, e.g. 'R01'. Blank/null if unreviewed.

reviewed_by_independent.description: True ONLY if reviewed by a fluent speaker of the entry's language who did NOT collect the entry (Layer 1, independent review). False otherwise, including when only Layer 2 cross-review or no review has happened.

source_url.description: REQUIRED when source_type="web-scraped": the exact page this entry was extracted from. Null/absent for human-collected source_types.

site_name.description: REQUIRED when source_type="web-scraped": the site's display name, e.g. 'African Storybook', 'Wikipedia (Yoruba)', for crediting in the dataset card.

retrieved_date.description: REQUIRED when source_type="web-scraped": the date this entry was actually fetched, format YYYY-MM-DD.

source_license.description: REQUIRED when source_type="web-scraped": the license the source text is published under, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'CC BY-SA 4.0'.

translation_source.description: REQUIRED when source_type="web-scraped": 'site' if translation_en is a genuine human translation taken from the source site itself, 'machine' if it was produced by machine translation. Null/absent for human-collected source_types (where the collecting contributor wrote the translation).
